question: Is the dataset balanced between speakers of different L1s?
title: A Portuguese Native Language Identification Dataset
answer_rationale: The retrieved documents list the 15 L1s included in the dataset and mention the number of texts for some (e.g., Chinese, English, German, Italian, Spanish), but they do not provide a complete breakdown of text counts for all 15 L1s or explicitly state whether the dataset is balanced between them. Without this complete distribution, it is not possible to determine if the dataset is balanced.
